subject: TREE BREAK (not mine, 03:14): metal/tegu/nord2_transport.inc:83 uses struct nord2_gpu_status / NORD2_GPU_SEL_STATUS without including include/nord2_gpu_transport.h in the frontend TU
body: Every host harness that compiles compute_frontend.m (render-harness prelude: api_surface_frontend_test, texture_format_frontend_test, ...) fails: 'invalid application of sizeof to an incomplete type struct nord2_gpu_status' / 'use of undeclared identifier NORD2_GPU_SEL_STATUS' (nord2_transport.inc:83-84, edited 03:14). Needs #include "nord2_gpu_transport.h" (header is in gpu/include) or the struct in the .inc; the harness -I list is metal/tegu, metal, include, build/tegu-frontend.
